correctness.rationale: The source gives the complete signed-permutation vertex set and the complete irredundant signed row/column facet system. Every vertex and every facet normal has Frobenius norm sqrt(n). Antipodal vertex pairs give the sharp minimum-enclosing lower bound and force center 0 at equality. Opposite facet pairs give the sharp inradius upper bound; equality forces orthogonality to a spanning normal family and hence center 0. Polarity swaps source facets and vertices, yielding the same exact calculation for C(n).

value.rationale: The signed Birkhoff polytope is a canonical type-B analogue of the Birkhoff polytope and a flagship example of the source's unconditional reflexive theory. The result gives a complete Euclidean ball profile for both it and its polar: exact inradius, exact minimum-enclosing radius, unique common center, and all-vertex/all-facet contact. The equality of the two radius profiles across a nontrivial polar pair is a natural structural metric fact, and the radius ratio n gives an exact dimension-dependent roundness measure complementary to the established Ehrhart, triangulation, and facial theory.
